chunks: From him, from Hammad, from Rib'i, from al-Fudayl, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
There is no harm in a man urinating in flowing water, and it is disliked that he urinate in still water.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection in legal context

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on urinating in flowing water versus still water in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning urination in water. It states that doing so in flowing water is not objectionable, while doing so in still water is disliked, indicating a distinction in ruling based on the nature of the water.
